translation: Took place in posad Serock, 7 February 1890, at 1 PM. Appeared personally Josek P[unclear]nik, shopkeeper, 60, and Berk Kaltun[?], attendant, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 6 PM in posad Serock died a male child named Pinkus Lejzor Tykulski, son of Moszek Gdala and of the mother Chaja Frajda née P[unclear]nik, the Tykulski spouses, six months of age. Upon eyewitness certification of the child's death this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and one witness.
